material_name: Rigid plastic (PET, HDPE, PP, PS containers/bottles/jars)
recycling_requirement: Recycling shall conform to IS 14534:1998 Guidelines for Recycling of Plastics
collection_requirement: Producer/Brand Owner must register on CPCB EPR portal; collection via registered PWP/ULBs
recycled_content_requirement: Not separately specified in source for rigid category

material_name: Flexible plastic - single or multilayer (pouches, sachets, carry bags, plastic sheets)
recycling_route: Mechanical recycling (single-layer) / limited options for multilayer
recycling_requirement: Recycling shall conform to IS 14534:1998; carry bags min. 50 micron thickness
collection_requirement: Producer/Brand Owner must register on CPCB EPR portal

material_name: Multilayered plastic packaging (≥1 plastic layer + ≥1 non-plastic layer)
recycling_route: Energy recovery, co-processing in cement kilns, or road construction (per Indian Road Congress guidelines) if non-recyclable
recycling_requirement: Non-recyclable MLP to be phased out within 2 years of rule notification
collection_requirement: Producer/Brand Owner must register on CPCB EPR portal
end_of_life: Energy recovery / phase-out of non-recyclable types

recycling_requirement: Must conform to IS/ISO 17088:2008; degradability tested per Schedule-I standards
collection_requirement: Certified compostable bags must bear certificate number
recycled_content_requirement: Not applicable (bio-based feedstock, not recycled content)

material_name: Paper and paperboard (kraft paper, corrugated fibreboard, cartons)
recycling_requirement: Not covered under Plastic Waste Management Rules (separate paper recycling stream)
recycled_content_requirement: Recycled content already common (Grade 2/3 kraft paper)

recycling_requirement: Not covered under Plastic Waste Management Rules
collection_requirement: Municipal solid waste / textile waste collection
